title: Filing requirements.
officialText:
Where submittal documents are required in connection with full or partial demolition in
accordance with Section 3306.5, applications shall be filed by the registered design professional in accordance with Article 104
of Chapter 1 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code and shall be approved prior to issuance of the work permit.
